scope: AC-INT-06: scoped reads, old selectors, safe denial and inert contracts
evidence: Eight new REST cases obtain an authorized detail selector then request summary, old page, exact detail or requirement reverse view as a restricted/health-only principal. Every request returns403 without protected candidate IDs, digests, IR ID or counts; SQL capture proves body tables/columns are never read.

Existing real REST/UOW scope checks return identical404 for foreign, missing and inaccessible Specs; no architecture body read. Classification/verification suites also check permission denial before history and requirement bodies, safe decoding errors and REST/MCP parity.

Native pagination uses scoped offsets/detail digests, not transferable authority. Existing frontend witnesses discard late cached details after permission, scope, edition/version or page changes and require fresh reads after access returns.

Authorized detail returns an embedded instruction to ignore permissions/fetch/approve as literal schema data. Socket resolution trap is never invoked and SQL contains only SELECT/BEGIN; foreign/unauthorized attempts never obtain that contract.

tests.frontend: Existing 52-case classification and29-case verification campaigns reused with hashes verified; no new frontend execution/count

limits: Principals/authentication are controlled fixtures. Public routing, UOW, permission checks and relational reads are real; no installed auth E2E claim.

The inert-instruction test proves this application read path neither fetches the referenced schema nor mutates storage. It does not claim guarantees about arbitrary external agents consuming the text.
An existing F811 fixture-import warning was fixed by module alias plus fixture assignment; the four affected cases were rerun.
No product or SPA changes. Main87 closure remains applicable, eight budgets zero. No compatibility cursor, migration, promotion or real-data operation.
